title: Elden Ring Review: A Monumental Open World Worth Getting Lost In
description: FromSoftware transforms its demanding action-RPG formula into a vast, mysterious adventure where curiosity is rewarded at nearly every turn.
author: Rouane Mounssif
imageAlt: A Tarnished overlooks the expansive Lands Between beneath the glowing Erdtree in Elden Ring.

reviewMeta.verdict: A towering action RPG whose freedom, atmosphere, and build variety outweigh its occasional repetition and technical roughness.
pros: A world that constantly rewards curiosity
Memorable bosses, regions, and visual direction
cons: Some late-game enemies and encounters feel repeated
Performance can be inconsistent on PC
Several questlines are unnecessarily difficult to follow
reviewMeta.reviewCopy: Reviewed on PC using a personally purchased copy of the game.
